title: Android Video Observation final-AC repair
details: Removes the forced requestData call that could collide with MediaRecorder stop on an Android chunk boundary and leave the final LO stuck
Keeps the native dataavailable then stop finalisation sequence intact instead of trying to manufacture a normal stop
Prefers the mature WebM MediaRecorder path on Android while retaining MP4 recording support for Apple devices
Keeps the short live-save WebM rewrite bypass so persistence stays responsive, while later playback and export can still repair seekability
Keeps existing Milos learner data, observations, reviews, QR, evidence and document formats unchanged
